title: Taurus: your window
to move abroad
summary: You have felt stuck where you are, and a door to somewhere far is opening. What changes for a Taurus Moon on December 5, how long it lasts, and your windows through 2027.
film: Taurus: your window to move abroad
imageAlt: Maya holding a Taurus flag, with the bull and a suitcase beside her
inside: Why home may have felt too small for a Taurus Moon lately
What opens on December 5, and how long it stays open
Your windows through 2027, with their dates, and what to do in each
intro: If you are a Taurus by Moon sign, you may have spent the last year and a half half in love with the idea of leaving. A course in another country. A job in a bigger city. Simply a life that does not look like the one you grew up in. And yet nothing quite moved.

The tradition has a reason for that stuck feeling, and a date when the picture changes: December 5. This guide explains what was going on, what opens, how long it lasts, and which months of 2027 are read as the most supportive for a plan that takes you far from home. It describes what the tradition reads, not what will happen. Your own choices and your own birth chart decide the rest.

sections.label: Why you felt stuck
title: Restless at work,
detached at home.
paragraphs: Since May 18, 2025, the quiet, detached influence the tradition calls the tail of the dragon has been in your house of home, the fourth house counted from your Moon sign. It is pictured as a body with no head: it does not cling and it does not chase. In the house of home it is read as a loosening. The place you live stops feeling like yours in the old way, even when nothing is actually wrong with it.

Over the same months its other half, the hungry head of the dragon, has been in your house of career, the tenth house. That is read as ambition without rest: wanting a bigger stage and never feeling that the current one is enough.

Put the two together and you get the feeling many Taurus Moons describe. Home feels too small, work feels too small, and there is no obvious door out. Taurus is the sign that likes roots, so the urge to go can feel confusing, almost disloyal. It is not. The tradition simply reads this as a stretch that loosens your grip on the familiar so that you can see what you want next.

sections.label: December 5
title: The far door
opens.
paragraphs: On Saturday, December 5, the hungry head of the dragon moves into your house of far journeys, the ninth house. In the tradition this is the planet of all things foreign: far places, other cultures, whatever lies past the edge of what you know. The ninth house is long journeys, higher study, teachers and luck. The two belong together, which is why astrologers pay attention when they meet.

It stays there for about eighteen months, until June 23, 2028. For a Taurus Moon this is read as a long season of wanting more than home can hold: study abroad, work in another country, a move far from where you began, or at the very least a hunger for teachers and ideas from far away.

On the same day the detached tail leaves your house of home and moves to your house of effort and courage, the third house. Home is read as feeling like home again, which matters: you are no longer choosing between a place that feels empty and a place that is far. You can want to go and still love where you come from.

rows.note: The planet of far places enters your house of far journeys and stays until June 23, 2028. Read as the start of a long window for study, work or a move far from home.
The planet of luck is in your house of home. Read as family support and a settled base while you start to plan.
The planet of luck moves to your house of effort, the third house. Read as good months for applications, short trips, learning a language and asking questions.
The slow planet of patience visits your house of foreign lands, the twelfth house. Read as the stretch that most supports a real move, and also the one that asks the most of you.
The planet of luck returns to your house of home. Read as family and roots holding steady while the far plan takes shape.
The planet of luck moves on to your house of joy and creativity, the fifth house. The far door stays open into 2028.

sections.label: The honest catch
title: June to October
is costly and slow.
paragraphs: The twelfth house is foreign lands, and it is also the house of expenses, endings and time spent away from the familiar. The slow planet of patience does nothing quickly. So the tradition reads June 2 to October 18, 2027 as months when a far plan can become real, and when it tends to cost more, take longer and feel lonelier than you pictured.

That is not a warning to stay put. This planet is the teacher of the sky, and what it builds is said to last. A move that survives forms, waiting and a careful budget is a move you really wanted. The useful side of this stretch is that it turns a daydream into something with dates and a plan.

It also helps that for most of those months, from June 25, the planet of luck is back in your house of home. The tradition reads that as the people and places you come from staying warm behind you while you look outward.

steps.name: Name the place
steps.text: Before December 5, write down where you would go and why. One country, one city, one reason. A vague wish to leave stays a wish. A named place can be planned.

steps.name: Start in December, slowly
steps.text: The window is about eighteen months long. You do not need to leap in the first week. Begin the research, the conversations and the first small step, and let it take its time.

steps.name: Use the first half of 2027 to prepare
steps.text: January 24 to June 24 is read as good for effort and learning. Take the course, practise the language, visit if you can, and talk to people who have already made the move you are thinking about.

steps.name: Expect the summer to be slow
steps.text: From June to October, plan for things to take longer and cost more than you hoped, and do not read a delay as a no. Patience is the whole lesson of that stretch.

steps.name: Pack a little bit of home
steps.text: You are a sign that needs roots. Keep your rituals, your food and your people close, wherever you are. The tradition reads home as your steady ground this year, so lean on it.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know. You can find yours for free on AstrolGuru with your birth date, time and place.

faq.q: Does this mean I will move abroad?
faq.a: No one can promise that. The tradition reads these months as a time when far places pull at a Taurus Moon and plans to go are supported. Whether you go depends on your choices, your circumstances and your own birth chart.

faq.q: What if I do not want to leave home?
faq.a: Then the same window is read in its other meanings: higher study, a teacher from another culture, long trips, or work with people far away. The house of far journeys is about a wider world, and you can reach it without moving.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
